Nina (sales-eng): Heads-up: POC kickoff with ClearWave tomorrow. They want strict separation: SSO-only invites, SCIM sync, ephemeral CI creds, and billing-view isolated. Also ask whether we can auto-provision service accounts from their IdP.
Omar (infra): We support SCIM provisioning; they can POST invite payloads or we can accept SCIM sync with group-to-role mapping. To enforce no static keys set workspace flag `disable_static_keys`.
Priya (security): Least-privilege suggestion: `svc-inference` (mint ephemeral tokens, call inference), `billing-view` (billing only), `auditor` (viewer), `model-uploader` only if necessary. Enforce SAML with encrypted assertions and optional IP allowlist for token minting.
Lena (acct exec): Pricing note: for a two-week spike we can offer a small Dedicated trial (prorated) if they expect sustained concurrency. Otherwise hosted with credits.
Nina (sales-eng): Can you paste a one-line invite payload for their automation?
Omar (infra): Minimal SCIM-friendly invite JSON:
```json
{"email":"ci@clearwave.com","display_name":"ClearWave POC CI","roles":["svc-inference"],"scim_group":"clearwave-poc","expires_at":"2026-12-01T00:00:00Z"}
```
Omar (infra): CLI example to mint ephemeral token (1h):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/workspaces/clearwave/ephemeral_tokens \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" -d '{"role":"svc-inference","ttl_seconds":3600}'
```
onboard-bot: Onboarding link: https://console.redwood.ai/onboard/clearwave (valid 6 days) :link:
Priya (security): Action items: I'll draft the questionnaire reply and SAML attribute mapping. Omar: please include SCIM endpoints in the docs. Lena: prepare pricing options. Nina: I'll loop back with the invite template and least-privilege checklist. :thumbsup:
